transcript.text: ภาพที่ค่อยค่อยจาง รักที่ไม่มีทาง เรื่องระหว่างเรามันได้จบลงไปแล้วแบบนี้

translations.ja: 徐々に薄れていく景色、ありえない愛、僕たちの物語はこうして終わりを迎えてしまった
translations.en: The fading images, a love with no way out, things between us have ended just like this.
translations.ko: 서서히 옅어져 가는 기억, 갈 수 없는 사랑. 우리 사이의 이야기는 이렇게 끝이 났어
translations.zh-TW: 漸漸褪色的畫面，沒有出路的愛，我們之間的故事就這樣結束了
translations.id: Bayangan yang perlahan memudar, cinta yang tak ada jalan keluar, kisah di antara kita telah berakhir begitu saja
translations.pt: As imagens desaparecendo aos poucos, o amor sem saída, a nossa história acabou assim

translations.ja: もう戻ろうなんて思わない、素直に受け入れるよ、僕たちは結ばれる運命じゃなかったんだ
translations.en: Not thinking of turning back, accepting it well, We're never ever meant to be.
translations.ko: 돌아갈 생각은 없어, 기꺼이 받아들일게 우린 애초에 안 될 운명이었으니까
translations.zh-TW: 沒想過要回頭，我能欣然接受 We're never ever meant to be
translations.id: Tak berniat untuk kembali, aku menerimanya dengan baik. Kita memang ditakdirkan tak bersama
translations.pt: Sem pensar em voltar, aceito bem isso. Nós nunca fomos feitos um para o outro

translations.ja: そして君が新しい誰かに出会う日、その人が全てにおいて素晴らしい人であってほしい
translations.en: And on the day you find someone, I wish for him to be good in every way.
translations.ko: 네가 다른 누군가를 만나게 되는 날엔, 그 사람이 모든 면에서 좋은 사람이기를 바랄게

translations.id: Dan hari saat kau bertemu seseorang, semoga dia menjadi orang yang baik dalam segalanya
translations.pt: E no dia em que você encontrar alguém, espero que ele seja bom em tudo

translations.pt: Espero que vocês se dêem bem, diferente de mim, mas bem lá no fundo do meu coração

translations.pt: Eu não quero que você me apague, não importa quanto tempo passe
